note: Montana FWP fishing access site on West Fork Fish Creek with designated primitive camping: 35 miles west of Missoula on I-90 to Exit 66, then south about 10 miles on Fish Creek Road. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms 'No fee charged for camping' (fees, priced as two conservation licenses per AWH, manual, left), the 25-ft trailer limit, the 7-day stay limit (now in booking), toilet, hand launch, primitive campsites. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note corrected ('FWP camping fee' -> FWP says no camping fee) and trimmed of restated facilities, limits and FCFS.
